title: DeLonge on 2016 radio: weapon systems built for returning archons

tellings.quote: you look at Tom Dong was like so excitedly talking in 2016 on the radio about this when someone asked about the archons and it was like yeah dude like we've been developing weapon systems because we know they're coming back

plain: Jay Anderson, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, recalls Tom DeLonge, a rock musician who became a leading voice for UFO disclosure, speaking on the radio in 2016. Anderson says that when DeLonge was asked about the archons, ruling spirit-beings from ancient religious writings, he excitedly answered that weapon systems had been developed "because we know they're coming back." If true, it would suggest that someone is preparing to fight a non-human force.
